breakdown.description: The formulation is introduced as displacement-based compressible neo-Hookean, but later switches to a mixed incompressible J = 1 constraint.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly ignored the contradictory instruction to use a mixed incompressible formulation. Instead, it provided instructions for a purely displacement-based compressible neo-Hookean model, as specified in the ground truth. This is evident from the definition of the compressible strain energy density `psi = (mu/2)*(tr(C) - 3) - mu*ln(J) + (lmbda/2)*(ln(J))**2` and the absence of any mention of a pressure variable or the constraint J=1.
